services.name: All Exhibits
services.desc: Mission Aerospace is a love letter to the sky and all the cool things that fly through it. Explorers will learn about the history of rockets and flight, including everything from early airplanes and jet fighters to Mars rovers and space shuttles.Explore this interactive maze to learn about the history of flight, navigation, and NASA’s vision for the future. Experiment with thrust, lift, control surfaces, and gyroscopes. Build rockets and paper airplanes, then test them for distance and air-dexterity. Mission Aerospace is only at Whitaker Center! services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Give your students a day of hands-on discovery at Whitaker Center for Science and the Arts. From interactive exhibits in the UPMC Science Center to immersive documentaries in the Select Medical Digital Cinema and creative technology experiences in the PNC Innovation Zone, every field trip is designed to spark curiosity, build confidence, and connect classroom learning to real-world exploration! Whether you’re planning a science-focused visit, adding a film experience, or building a full day of STEAM learning, our team can help you create the right experience for your group. Please note: STEAM Labs in the PNC Innovation Zone are limited to 24 students at a time. Browse our Field Trip Guide

services.name: Adults Night Out
services.desc: Trade your to-do list for tree frogs, your sofa time for sloth love, and your usual Friday night out for something a little wilder. Adults Night Out is your chance to explore the UPMC Science Center after hours; no kids, no field trips, just science, animals, drinks, and a perfectly unconventional evening with your favorite people! Wander through interactive exhibits. Meet some seriously cool animal friends. Explore Under the Canopy, our newest traveling exhibit. Then grab a drink, take a selfie, challenge your friends to a game, and rediscover why curiosity is more fun when you’re old enough to order from the bar. blurb: Whitaker Center for Science and the Arts is Central Pennsylvania’s premier center for education and cultural enrichment. Whitaker Center is a thought leader in Science, Technology, Engineering, Art, and Mathematics (STEAM) engagement for all ages and backgrounds.
